messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Sarah Turner <sarah.turner@talentfirm.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Confidential: Manager rotation for Data Platform — probation & coaching plan

Team — confidential heads-up and request for approvals.

Context: The Data Platform team will shift managers for one of the mid-tier pods; Amit Verma (IC) has requested a formal change after ongoing performance conversations. To avoid disruption we propose a short interim rotation: Marissa will step in as interim manager for the pod for an 8-week probation period starting 2026-04-28. During that time we want a clear coaching and evaluation plan (MAP) to assess readiness for a permanent manager assignment.

Planned actions (attached):
- Start date: 2026-04-28
- Duration: 8 weeks (probation review at week 6, final decision week 8)
- Coaching: weekly 1:1s with Marissa + biweekly calibration with me and Laura
- External coach: Sarah Turner (copied) to run two focused coaching sessions and provide an interim readiness memo
- Deliverables: probation-checklist-v1.xlsx (attached), manager-transition-MAP.docx (attached)

Asks:
1) Monica — please confirm HR checklist, employment notice requirements, and whether we need a signed acknowledgement from Amit to proceed. Also let us know required payroll/status updates for an interim manager.
2) Laura — do you approve this interim rotation and the 8-week probation cadence?
3) Marissa — please confirm availability for the coaching windows (Mon/Tue mornings) and acceptance of interim responsibilities.

This is sensitive — please keep the thread limited. I will prepare the official offer/acknowledgement if we get HR sign-off. Attaching the two docs for review.

Thanks,
Vivek
---
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Confidential: Manager rotation for Data Platform — probation & coaching plan

Vivek — thanks for the detailed plan and for keeping HR in the loop. A few HR items before we proceed: 

1) Employee consent: We should get a written acknowledgement from Amit confirming he understands the interim assignment and the evaluation criteria. If he agrees, we will ask him to sign the acknowledgement form (I can send a DocuSign link once language is finalized).
2) Compensation/status: Interim manager stipends are handled case-by-case. If Marissa will be taking on manager-level responsibilities (performance reviews, hiring authority, salary band conversations), we should confirm whether she expects an interim stipend. Please confirm.
3) Documentation: The attached probation-checklist looks good overall; HR will add the mandatory probation review fields (work objectives, success criteria, escalation path). I will version it as probation-checklist-v1.1.xlsx and re-upload to the Drive link.
4) Compliance & privacy: Because this is a personnel change with potential PII, mark the thread and attachments as confidential in the HR system. Do not forward outside the listed recipients.

Next steps from HR: I will draft the acknowledgement template and the DocuSign envelope. Please provide Amit's email (we have it on file) and let me know if you want the acknowledgement to include the external coach engagement.

Monica
Monica Patel
Senior People Partner, People Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Confidential: Manager rotation for Data Platform — probation & coaching plan

Vivek, Monica — I support the proposed interim rotation and the 8-week cadence. Approved with following notes: 

- Timeline: approved start 2026-04-28. Please ensure Marissa has a clear handoff meeting with Amit this week (skip non-essential meetings for the pod during the transition day).
- Calibration: I will join the week-6 review and expect to see the probation checklist populated with specific, measurable objectives (3 focus areas max).
- Communication: Keep the announcement to the pod small and factual; surface-level messaging only. I'll work with Comms on a short line for the team if needed.
- Stipend: I authorize an interim stipend up to 7.5% for scope above 30% additional manager time; we can decide once Marissa confirms hours. Monica — please prepare an offer for stipend approval and routing.

Please confirm Amit's consent and Marissa's availability; once Monica sends the DocuSign I'll route for signature.

Thanks,
Laura

Thanks all — quick confirmations: 
- Marissa: available and accepting the interim manager assignment; she confirms Mon/Tue mornings work for coaching sessions.
- Amit: I spoke with him this morning; he understands the interim rotation and is open to the probation process. Monica — please send the acknowledgement to amit.verma@redwood.com and include the external coach in the communications as appropriate.
- Stipend: Marissa is open to discussing interim compensation; we'll keep it flexible pending actual hours.

I'll wait for Monica's DocuSign link and the updated checklist (v1.1). Once signed, I'll schedule the handoff meeting and calendar the week-6 review with Laura.

Appreciate the fast turnaround on this one — keeping it tight and confidential.

Vivek
